scripts.dev: bun run prune:auto && bun run --cwd apps/desktop dev
scripts.build: bun run prune:auto && bun run --cwd apps/desktop build
scripts.tauri: bun run prune:auto && bun run --cwd apps/desktop tauri
scripts.app: bun run prune:auto && bun run --cwd apps/desktop tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.bundle: bun run prune:auto && bun run --cwd apps/desktop tauri build
scripts.bundle:dev: bun run prune:auto && bun run --cwd apps/desktop tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.icons: bun run --cwd apps/desktop tauri icon src-tauri/icon.svg && bun run --cwd apps/desktop tauri icon src-tauri/icon-dev.svg -o src-tauri/icons/dev
